print.caveat: CMYK here is an uncalibrated device conversion, which is a starting point and not a match. Confirm against a printed proof on the actual stock before anything is ordered.

dataViz.note: A brand palette is built for hierarchy and a chart palette is built for discrimination. Categorical colours here are checked to stay apart under protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia, which the brand ramps are not.

4xl.name: 4xl
4xl.use: Display, one per page at most

weights.name: regular
weights.use: Body text, and everything that is not asking for attention

weights.name: medium
weights.use: UI labels, buttons, table headers: emphasis without shouting

weights.name: bold
weights.use: Display type and the one word in a sentence that carries it

elevation.name: none
elevation.use: Flat. The default for most things

elevation.name: sm
elevation.use: A card that is merely not the page

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.use: Above a large phone. Two columns of small controls become possible.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.use: Tablet portrait. A single column can become two.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.use: Laptop. Sidebars and three-column grids hold.

breakpoints.name: xl
breakpoints.use: Where the fluid type stops growing, so the layout stops with it.

layout.note: Breakpoints are a starting set. The real ones are wherever this layout breaks, and you find those by dragging the window rather than by naming devices.

durations.name: instant
durations.use: Anything that must feel like a direct manipulation

durations.name: slow
durations.use: Panels, drawers, anything crossing the screen

durations.name: slower
durations.use: Page and route transitions. Rarely anything else

emphasis.use: A single overshoot. One per screen at most

focus.note: Outline, never a box-shadow: an outline is not clipped by overflow.
